name: Watch repair and servicing
summary: How expats find watch repair and authorised servicing in Singapore — battery changes, pressure tests after swimming, and when grey-import pieces complicate warranty paths.
body:
Humidity, pool days, and MRT bumps punish watches. Services range from walk-in battery/gasket swaps to full manufacturer service centres for automatics and divers.

## Typical jobs
- Battery and gasket replacement with pressure testing
- Strap/bracelet adjustments and spring-bar swaps
- Crystal polishing or replacement
- Full service (clean, oil, regulate) for mechanicals
- Authenticity checks before second-hand buys

Authorised centres protect warranty; independents can be faster/cheaper out of warranty — ask what parts they use.

## How to choose
For dive watches, insist on pressure testing after battery work. Keep service papers for resale. Grey-import warranty may require regional detours — check before buying. Avoid street “ultrasonic clean” pitches that open cases without proper seals.

## Practical tip
Photograph the watch and note the serial before drop-off. Remove smart-watch cellular SIMs if sending connected devices for hardware work.
